fields.title: Haystack News record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of Haystack's own API shapes. Every record carries _input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType (and _error / _errorDetail on failures). Upstream field names are preserved verbatim, so a VIDEO row is a Haystack stream object and a LOCAL_EVENT row is a PredictHQ-derived event object. Use recordType to split a run's mixed output into tables.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact target, video URL, query or city that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which endpoint emitted the row: S1-playlist-<kind>, S1-search, S1-channel, S1-sitemap, S2-sitemap-xml, S1-polls-ssr, S1-localEvents, or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: VIDEO, VIDEO_DETAIL, TAG_GROUP, CHANNEL, CATEGORY, VIDEO_CATEGORY, LIVE_CHANNEL, SPECIAL_STREAM, LOCATION, TOPIC, POLL, LOCAL_EVENT, LOCAL_EVENTS_SUMMARY, or ERROR.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failure rows: not_found, empty_feed, no_results, no_events, location_unresolved, bad_input, invalid_request, auth_rejected, timeout, retries_exhausted, unexpected_shape, or exception.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Non-fatal degradation marker. premium_capped_partial_harvest on a LOCAL_EVENTS_SUMMARY means Haystack withheld events from anonymous callers.

title.title: Title
title.description: Video headline, channel name, or event name depending on recordType.

videoId.title: Video ID
videoId.description: Haystack's short video id, e.g. 6daOFLevf. Added by this actor from streamUrl.

webUrl.title: Web URL
webUrl.description: Added by this actor -- the human-facing haystack.tv permalink for the row.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: URL slug of the video or channel.

author.title: Author
author.description: VIDEO rows -- the publishing channel's short name, e.g. bloomberg, khou.

publishedDate.title: Published at
publishedDate.description: VIDEO rows -- when the clip was published, ISO 8601.

ageLabel.title: Age label
ageLabel.description: VIDEO rows -- Haystack's human-readable freshness, e.g. '3h ago'.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: VIDEO rows -- clip length in seconds.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: VIDEO rows -- every Haystack category the clip belongs to.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: VIDEO rows -- topic tags attached to the clip, each {tag: ...}.

popularityScore.title: Popularity score
popularityScore.description: VIDEO rows -- Haystack's internal popularity ranking for the clip.

mediaFiles.title: Media files
mediaFiles.description: VIDEO rows -- HLS manifests (adaptive, hd720, audio) on Haystack's CDN.

cc.title: Captions
cc.description: VIDEO rows -- closed-caption tracks, usually a WebVTT URL per language.

snapshotHighUrl.title: Thumbnail
snapshotHighUrl.description: VIDEO rows -- 480x270 thumbnail; snapshotUrl and snapshot720Url carry other sizes.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: VIDEO rows -- the publishing channel object: name, title, tag, thumbnail.

feedTitle.title: Feed title
feedTitle.description: VIDEO rows -- which feed this clip was collected from, e.g. 'Current Events'.

playlistId.title: Playlist ID
playlistId.description: VIDEO rows -- the playlist snapshot the clip came from.

llm.title: AI classification
llm.description: VIDEO_DETAIL rows only -- Haystack's own model output: primaryCategory, contentType, scope, urgency, editorialStance, primaryUserNeed, primaryEmotion, emotionalIntensity, broadAppeal, headlineMagnetism, narrativeResolution.

exit_ratio.title: Exit ratio
exit_ratio.description: VIDEO_DETAIL rows only -- share of viewers who left during the clip; with exit_users and total_users_for_exit this is Haystack's retention signal.

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: VIDEO_DETAIL rows only -- the publisher's own page for the story.

haystackTags.title: Haystack tags
haystackTags.description: VIDEO_DETAIL rows only -- internal editorial tags.

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: TAG_GROUP / TOPIC rows -- the topic slug, e.g. trump.

numVideos.title: Videos in topic
numVideos.description: TAG_GROUP rows -- how many videos in the feed carry this topic.

name.title: Name
name.description: CHANNEL / CATEGORY / LOCATION rows -- the internal identifier.

path.title: Path
path.description: CATEGORY rows -- the site path, e.g. /news.

results.title: Poll results
results.description: POLL rows -- added by this actor: one {choice, votes, pct} per option.

totalVoteCount.title: Total votes
totalVoteCount.description: POLL rows -- votes cast across all choices.

startDate.title: Starts at
startDate.description: POLL / LOCAL_EVENT rows -- when the poll opened or the event begins.

endDate.title: Ends at
endDate.description: POLL / LOCAL_EVENT rows -- when the poll closes or the event ends.

labels.title: Event labels
labels.description: LOCAL_EVENT rows -- category tags such as concert, festival, sports.

location.title: Venue
location.description: LOCAL_EVENT rows -- lat, lon, venue, address, city, state, postalCode.

local_rank.title: Local rank
local_rank.description: LOCAL_EVENT rows -- PredictHQ's local impact score for the event.

metadata.title: Event metadata
metadata.description: LOCAL_EVENT rows -- provenance plus the untouched upstream record under metadata.raw.

_slice.title: Harvest slice
_slice.description: LOCAL_EVENT rows -- which filter combination surfaced this event, e.g. sort=date&category=sports.

eventsHarvested.title: Events harvested
eventsHarvested.description: LOCAL_EVENTS_SUMMARY rows -- unique events collected for the city.

eventsTotalUpstream.title: Events upstream
eventsTotalUpstream.description: LOCAL_EVENTS_SUMMARY rows -- how many events Haystack says the city has.

eventsHiddenByPaywall.title: Events withheld
eventsHiddenByPaywall.description: LOCAL_EVENTS_SUMMARY rows -- how many Haystack withheld from anonymous callers.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across every record type this actor emits.

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: Video headlines with publisher, freshness and topics.

polls.title: Polls
polls.description: Poll questions with vote counts and computed percentages.

localEvents.title: Local events
localEvents.description: Events with venue, timing and local impact rank.
